eachRowOfDataAsMessage.description: Whether or not to send a separate message for each row of the data

teamName.description: Service team Name used for display purpose

AlertActionApi.description: Action API for messaging platform such as Teams and Slack

privateChannel.description: Whether or not this channel is private

id.description: ID of user or group to be shared to

name.description: Username + name or group name to be shared to.  When sharing to a user, either id field or the combination of name, externalAuthId, and ssoUser have to be specified

externalAuthId.description: External authenticate ID to be shared to

ssoUser.description: Whether or not user is SSO user

ok.description: Whether or not the response is a success

datasetId.description: Dataset ID to replace the alert's dataset ID for attachment

query.description: Additional C9QL to be applied prior to attachment

dashboardPdfId.description: Additional C9QL to be applied prior to attachment

alertCondition.description: Alert condition for conditional alert type

accessLevel.description: Access level of the alert for current user

realtime.description: Whether or not this alert is real-time alert

firedCount.description: Number of times this alert has been triggered

deletable.description: Whether or not the current user has deletion right to the alert

alertIfNoData.description: Whether or not to send alert of there is no data returned

skipSameAlert.description: Whether or not to send alert if data is the same as previous alert

attachDataset.description: Whether or not to attach raw dataset data

attachAlertData.description: Whether or not to attach raw dataset data

fieldName.description: Filter field name. Either fieldName or fieldNames has to be not empty

fieldNames.description: Filter field names in case of tree filter. Either fieldName or fieldNames has to be not empty

items.description: Filter field names in case of tree filter. Either fieldName or fieldNames has to be not empty

operator.example: =,!=,>,>=,<,<=,Equals,Not Equals,Greater than,Greater than or equals,Less than,Less than or equals,is null,is not null,Range,Contains,Does Not Contain

locked.description: Whether or not filter is locked (ie: not modifiable)

requireValue.description: Whether or not filter requires value to be set

enabled.description: Whether or not filter is enabled (default is true)

visible.description: Whether or not filter is visible (default is true)

hitListLabel.description: Suggestion label field name of the hit list dataset

hitListValue.description: Suggestion value field name of the hit list dataset

filteringResult.description: Whether the filter should be applied before (false) or after (true) the widget data has been processed

or.description: Whether this filter is OR'd with the previous filter (for SQL parsing)

dateLimitOptions.description: Filter date limit options (restriction and from token)

plainControlType.description: Control type for plain text field type

dynamic.description: Whether or not filter's value is automatically selected

inclusiveTime.description: Whether time range filter is inclusive (includes exact start/end times, where start time is for Start Date and end time for End Date. UI tooltip: When checked, creates a single continuous time period from Start Date/Time to End Date/Time. When unchecked, applies the time range to each day separately (e.g., 9:00-17:00 every day within the date range).)

groupHeading.description: Whether this entry is a display-only group heading (fieldName contains the heading text)

divider.description: Whether this entry is a display-only divider between filter groups

startTime.description: Start time. This can either be time HH:mm or date time MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm

twoFactorBySms.description: Is two factor login by SMS enabled

twoFactorByEmail.description: Is two factor login by EMAIL enabled

limitSharing.description: If true, this user can only share assets with members of this group

accessLevel.description: User's access level for this group (0=Admin, 1=Edit, 2=View)
Access level of the report for current user

tokenType.description: Token type currently only allow bearer
